answer: We bind each agent identity to a unique proof-of-work nonce sealed in a TLA+ verified registration kernel, so a sybil must burn distinct capital per pseudonym rather than minting a free plume of keys. Asynchronous Byzantine quorum certificates then require every epoch's sonnet of attestations to carry a bonded stake deposit, making identity replication costly as carving marble. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
